conceptZh: 兩隻胖胖玩具鳥想搶中間的位置，小小鳥卻先坐上正中央的最高點。
object: A crimson 中-shaped toy perch and three wind-up cartoon birds
morph: The perch is already the complete glyph: a closed rectangular outline crossed at its exact midpoint by one straight vertical stroke extending above and below it.
creativeAngle: 把「中」變成搶座位的玩具鳥棲架；兩隻大鳥努力往中間擠，小鳥卻輕鬆占據中央高點，用大小反差製造笑點。
promptEn:
Create an 8-second stylized 3D toy animation with a locked frontal camera, a pale butter-yellow background, and bright, softly lit materials. Center one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 中, rendered as a saturated solid crimson toy perch, filling approximately 70% of frame height with generous margins. Its closed rectangular outline has straight horizontal and vertical sides; a single straight vertical stroke passes through the exact center and extends clearly above and below the rectangle. Keep this geometry rigid, fully visible, centered, and uncropped throughout.

At the opening, two plump wind-up cartoon birds perch symmetrically on the rectangle’s upper edge, their feet touching but never covering the red strokes. From 0.3–2.3 seconds, they take increasingly tiny sideways steps toward the central upright, each trying to claim the middle seat. Their round bodies stop short of the upright; both stare up at its empty top tip. Pause briefly in anticipation. At 2.7 seconds, a comically tiny wind-up bird drops gently onto that exact central tip and sits proudly. The two enormous birds simultaneously tip their heads back to look at the miniature winner, wobbling on their little mechanical feet in a synchronized silent double take. The glyph remains perfectly still. From 3.5–4.6 seconds, all three birds flutter out through the side margins. Hold the completely unobstructed crimson 中 motionless from 4.6–8.0 seconds, with no further action or camera movement.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly 「中、中、中間」, pronouncing 中 as ㄓㄨㄥ. Place the first 中 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 1.5 seconds, and 中間 around 5.4–6.3 seconds during the clear final hold. Use natural short pauses and stop after the word. Add only very soft wind-up clicks and flutter sounds beneath the voice; no music is needed. The single target glyph 中 is the only on-screen writing. Keep the vocabulary audio-only, with no subtitles, other text, watermark, clutter, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 愛衝過頭的發條賽車想停在正中間，車頭卻拉成手風琴；彈回中央後，才得意地沿著中線離開。
object: An original googly-eyed pull-back toy race car and a solid red 中 laid flat on a pale cream floor.
morph: The glyph is complete from the opening. Its central vertical stroke serves as the parking target and exit route; the car's accordion recoil demonstrates returning to the middle without changing the strokes.
creativeAngle: 改用賽車煞車時的手風琴式伸縮笑點：輪子停了，車頭還想衝！回彈後恰好停在中央，以位置和動作教「中」，不再沿用鳥搶座位或棒子穿盒子的構想。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D toy animation with a locked overhead camera and soft, bright lighting. On a pale cream floor, center one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 中 in saturated solid vermilion, occupying about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins. Render it as a crisp, flat toy-road marking: a closed rectangular outline crossed through its exact midpoint by one straight vertical stroke extending clearly above and below the rectangle. Preserve this complete geometry throughout, centered and uncropped, with no perspective distortion.

The sole animated lead is an original turquoise pull-back toy race car with googly eyes, tiny rubber wheels, a squeaky spring mechanism, and an absurdly confident grin. Its body is small enough to fit comfortably inside either rectangular opening. Use only this car and the glyph, with no additional props or road markings.

At the opening, the car waits inside the left half of the rectangle, pointing right toward the central vertical stroke. It eagerly glances at that middle stripe, rolls backward a tiny distance to wind itself, and releases at 0.8 seconds. It races across the stripe, trying to park in the middle but overshooting into the right half. At 1.8 seconds its wheels abruptly grip the floor, while its flexible toy body keeps stretching forward into a ridiculous accordion snout. Keep the entire stretched car inside the rectangle, without touching its outer border. Its googly eyes slide their gaze backward toward the wheels as if astonished that the rest of it has stopped. Give this pose a brief, readable pause. A soft springy recoil then pulls the body together and scoots the whole car backward, landing precisely astride the central vertical stroke by 3.2 seconds. Its eyes settle after one tiny wobble; its grin returns with exaggerated pride. It turns downward and drives carefully along the central stroke, continuing straight beyond the lower tip and fully out of frame by 4.7 seconds. Leave no tire tracks or motion trails. Hold the completely unobstructed, motionless 中 from 4.7 through 8.0 seconds.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly 「中、中、中間」, with 中 pronounced ㄓㄨㄥ. Speak the first 中 around 0.3–0.7 seconds, the second around 1.1–1.5 seconds, and 中間 around 5.4–6.3 seconds while the finished glyph is fully visible. Use natural pauses and stop after the word. Keep the winding click, rubber squeak, and soft recoil sound quiet beneath the voice; use no music. The only on-screen writing is the single glyph 中. Keep the vocabulary audio-only, with no subtitles, logos, watermark, clutter, or flashing effects.
